svg.title: South Pacific Current: March 1990 relative-geostrophic band constraint
svg.desc: Author reports an enhanced eastward band less than 200 km wide near nominal 170 W. Relative to sigma2 = 36.75 kg/m3 at 1800-1840 m. Upper 1,000 m is field context, not a uniform width layer. Representative width, lower bound, exact days, geographic edges and numerical uncertainty unknown.100 km is an illustrative transport assumption; greater than500 km describes separation from northern ACC flow. No annual range or footprint.

g.text: South Pacific Current / Baldrige section d
March 1990 / nominal 170 W / enhanced eastward velocity band
Author-reported constraint; representative width and lower bound unknown.
Relative geostrophy: sigma2 = 36.75 kg/m3; reference 1800-1840 m.
Upper 1,000 m is field context; exact width-evaluation depth unresolved.
7 cm/s surface and 4 cm/s near 500 m are not edge cutoffs.
100 km: transport assumption. >500 km: separation from northern ACC flow.
No zero-to-200 interval, geographic width band, annual range or ranking.
Source: Stramma, Peterson and Tomczak (1995), p.82; Tables 1/2(d), Figure 3.
Independent OSW graphic. Original scan reviewed; source curves and edges not digitized.
